title: Email, Slack, and Teams notifications: alert operators on critical findings, phase completions, and run results
goal: AegisPT currently has SIEM push (Splunk/Elastic/Sentinel) and generic webhooks for findings. What is missing: (1) Email alerts via SMTP — when a Critical finding is discovered, send an email to configured addresses with: finding title, severity, target, remediation summary. Also send email on run completion and phase completion awaiting approval. (2) Slack webhook integration — post a message to a configured Slack channel with finding details and an approval link. (3) Microsoft Teams webhook — same as Slack but Teams Adaptive Card format. Implementation: Add an api/app/services/notification_delivery.py service modelled after siem_push.py. Add configuration in Settings: SMTP host/port/from/to, Slack webhook URL, Teams webhook URL. Trigger from the same location as SIEM push: workers/orchestration/tasks.py:2807-2833 after finding creation and run completion. Use encrypted credential storage (same pattern as Jira/SIEM integrations). All notification channels optional — system works if none configured.
scope: Code audit 2026-05-03: api/app/services/siem_push.py implements SIEM delivery. Generic webhooks exist. Email and chat platform notifications are absent. Enterprise clients expect to receive a Slack/Teams ping when a critical finding is discovered — waiting until they log in to check is not acceptable for high-severity findings.
generation_reason: Email and Slack/Teams notifications absent — enterprise operators need real-time alerts on critical findings without having to poll the dashboard.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add email + Slack + Teams. Do not change SIEM push, existing webhooks, or Jira integration. Keep all notifications optional.

success_criteria: When a Critical finding is created, configured email recipients receive an alert within 60s.
When a Critical finding is created, configured Slack channel receives a message.
When a Critical finding is created, configured Teams channel receives an Adaptive Card.
Run completion and phase-approval-needed events also trigger configured channels.
All channels optional — system works if none configured.
Credentials stored encrypted (same pattern as Jira/SIEM).
Settings screen has email/Slack/Teams configuration panels.

acceptance_criteria: Email alert sends on critical finding (verified with mock SMTP).
Slack webhook called on critical finding.
Teams webhook called on critical finding.
No crash if no channels configured.
